name: moonveilicons-repo
description: Moonveil Icons: an SVG icon library for npm, React, Vue, Web Components, webfont, CDN and CLI.

scripts.build: npm run generate && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/react/src/icons packages/react/src/index.ts packages/vue/src/icons packages/vue/src/index.ts packages/web-components/src/icons.ts packages/core/svg packages/core/icons.json
